• Blocking a hit grants 2 Stacks of Perfect Guard. Maximum of 100 Stacks. (Cannot gain stacks while you have the Restoration buff)
• Heavy Ammo Sword Energy does not decay from holding guard
All Stacks are removed if no hits have been blocked in the last 10 seconds.

4 [3] second duration at 1 Stack, scaling up to 16 [6] seconds at 100 Stacks. (Ember of Solace increases this by 50%, up to 24 [9] seconds)

src.bungie: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.

src.bungie: Defeating a target with melee or a finisher grants escalating melee damage, which decays over time. Higher levels of Burning Fists grant increased weapon damage.
src.clarity:
Finisher and (Glaive) Melee Kills grant a Stack of Burning Fists. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
After not having scored further Finisher or (Glaive) Melee Kills for 2 seconds, your Stacks start decaying one at a time over 9.5|10|4|4|3 seconds for the 1st|...|5th Stacks.
Damage Buff at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• Additional Base Melee Damage: 80%|160%|240%|320%|400%
• Additional Base Glaive Melee Damage: 40%|80%|120%|160%|200%
• Weapon, PVE: 0%|20%|25%|30%|35%
• Weapon, PVP: 0%|0%|20%|25%|25%
Weapon damage increases are Empowering Buffs.

On Melee, Glaive Melee, or Finisher Kill:
Grants a stack of Burning Fists, up to 5 stacks, increasing Melee and Weapon Damage per stack.

Burning Fist stack timer begins decaying after 2 seconds of gaining a stack.
Burning Fists:
x1 = 80% increased Melee Damage for 9.5 seconds.
x2 = 160% Melee Damage, and 20% Increased Weapon Damage for 10 seconds.
x3 = 240% Melee Damage, and 25% [20%] Weapon Damage for 4 seconds.

x5 = 400% Melee Damage, and 35% [25%] Weapon Damage for 3 seconds.
